errors.evidence: The description lists the values for the categories '1996–2001' and '2002–2007' out of the order they appear on the y-axis. In the chart, the category '2002-2007' is located above '1996-2001', but the description reverses this order when reporting their values, which can cause confusion when mapping the text to the visual chart.
The description states the bars are colored with a 'blue gradient'. The bars are solid blue and have a drop shadow effect, which is not a gradient.
